name: GlobalFoundries
old_description: GlobalFoundries operates the world's largest semiconductor fabrication plant in Malta, NY. Provides foundry manufacturing services for a variety of integrated circuits, serving customers in microelectronics, mobile, IoT and automotive markets.
about:
GlobalFoundries is headquartered in Malta, New York, and was founded in 2009 as a joint venture between Mubadala Investment Company and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) to address growing global demand for advanced semiconductors. The company's first major U.S. fabrication facility began construction in Malta in 2013, becoming a cornerstone of its advanced manufacturing strategy.

The company operates as a pure-play semiconductor foundry, providing wafer fabrication, advanced packaging, and test services for fabless chip designers and integrated device manufacturers. Its technology portfolio spans CMOS, FinFET, FDX™ FD-SOI, BCD, Power GaN, RF-SOI, SiGe, RF GaN, silicon photonics, and quantum-process platforms. Manufacturing sites include Malta (global headquarters), Burlington, Vermont (RF and GaN center of excellence), Dresden, Germany, Singapore, and Guangzhou, China, with a workforce of 5,000–9,999 employees.

GlobalFoundries serves aerospace and defense, automotive, data-center and communications infrastructure, home and industrial IoT, and smart mobile device markets. Customers include companies such as Marvell, which collaborates on high-performance SiGe technology for optical connectivity, and the firm has partnered with TSMC to establish a U.S.-based supply of silicon interposers for advanced CoWoS® packaging. The MIPS subsidiary provides processor IP and virtual platforms for software-to-silicon development.

The company emphasizes differentiation through deep co-innovation with customers, governments, and universities, combining R&D, IP, design, and manufacturing across a flexible global footprint. Its stated mission is to deliver trusted, essential chips that enable AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world, with a quality philosophy targeting zero excursions and zero defects.
